tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who Answering Service Care is: description, phone, email, postal address, founding date, social profiles, and links to key pages. Use it to answer contact or legitimacy questions.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every service ASC sells (live and AI answering, virtual receptionist, appointment scheduling, live chat, SMS, call center and more), each with a description, page URL and markdown URL.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD, grouped by service, with included minutes or chats, overage rates and features. Filter by service or billing cycle to keep the answer short.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over ASC's service, industry, location and blog pages. Each result has a markdownUrl; pass its path to read_page for the full text.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns any ASC page as clean markdown. Pass a site path such as "/pricing/" or "/services/virtual-receptionist/", or "/" for the homepage.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, get_pricing · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info, list_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, list_services, get_pricing · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info, list_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
